references.text: Balaam explained the same principle to Balak earlier: he can only speak the word God puts in his mouth.
Balaam repeats this principle again to Balak, that he must do everything the Lord says.
Balaam confirms once more that he cannot go beyond the Lord's word, neither for good nor for evil.
God promises to raise up a prophet whom He will put His words in the mouth of, a similar concept of divine speech.
The Lord touches Jeremiah's mouth and puts His words there, the same theme of prophetic speech given by God.
Ezekiel is commanded to speak God's words to the house of Israel, a similar call to convey a divine message.
